༄༅/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gsang gsum bzhugs so:bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la phyag 'tshal lo:rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying tig gi:bla ma'i rnal

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gsang gsum bzhugs so:

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying tig gi: bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par 'dod pas: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun: rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du: rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i cha byad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa: g.yon pa dngul dkar gyi dril bu dku la brten pa: ral pa'i thor tsug gyen du bcings shing lhag ma thur du grol ba: sku la dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa de'i spyi bor 'khor lo'i steng du oṃ dkar po: mgrin par pad+ma'i lte bar āḥdamar po: thugs kar nyi zla'i steng du hūṃ dkar po: hūṃ dkar po de la yi ge brgya pas bskor nas sgra rang grag tu 'khor bar bsam: yi ge gsum las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: rdo rje sems dpa' la thim rdo rje sems dpa' sngar bas sku che zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur: thugs ka'i hūṃ dkar po las zag med kyi bdud rtsi dngul chu'i mdog lta bu dkar shar gyis byon zhabs kyi mtheb chen las babs pas rang gi spyi gtsug tshangs ba'i bu ga nas mar babs nas : rtsa dbu ma'i nang na mar brgyud nas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da la thug gi bar du bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad nag 'dur gyis sol khu chus khyer ba bzhin du rtsa lam dang chu lam ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las thon nas rang nyid lus shel sgong dri ma med pa'am: phru ma phus btab pa bzhin du dang sangs kyis song bar bsam zhing : ma yengs par yi ge brgya pa ci nus su 'dren: rjes mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag: de ni phyi'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgrib pa sbyong ba'o:

nang ltar du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par 'dod pas: gong gi rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas hūm̐ḥdakar po tsheg drag dang ldan pa cig tu gyur: hūm̐ḥde las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang du gyur: nang bcud kyi sems can la phog pas rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du gyur: de rnams thams cad 'od du zhu nas hūṃḥdakar po'i rang bzhin du gyur: yang sngar gyi hūṃḥde las 'od zer 'phros pas hūṃḥde dag thams cad tshur bsdus rtsa ba'i hūm̐ḥl thim: hūm̐ḥde sngar bas gzi brjid dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur: de las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul: de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer hūṃḥl thim: hūṃḥyongs su gyur pa las bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog mthing kha rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa: yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med par gyur: de'i sku la dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa: yab yum gnyis su med pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ:dmar ser: de las 'od zer yar 'phros rtsa dbu ma'i nang na yar song bas: sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul: rang gi spyi bo'i thad ka khru gang gi thad du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du bla ma kun 'dus rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa: phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa: sku la dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa: de'i thugs kar hūṃ dkar po las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' la gdugs phub pa'i tshul du spung nge bzhugs par bsgom: de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' la thim pas rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas hūṃ dkar po:

rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ dmar ser gnyis sngags kyi phreng ba'i tshul du brgyud: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūṃ: zhes brjod pas: mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba tsam du rang bsgrag tu 'dren par bsam: thun mtshams su rlung bum pa can 'dzin: rjes mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag: nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro: gsang ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni: rang lus lha skur gsal btab nas: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la: yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: de bzhin bdag gis gsal gdab bo: gong du bsgoms pa rnams 'od du zhu ba las dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa hūṃ mthing kha zhig tu bsam: 'phro 'du gong dang 'dra: hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa: de'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog sngo skya gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa: yab yum gnyis ka'ang dar dang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa: de'i thugs kar rtsa 'dab bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis: de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa: de'i dbus su kun tu bzang po yab yum: rgyan med mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can: de'i shar du rdo rje sems dpa': lhor rin chen 'byung ldan: nub tu snang ba mtha' yas: byang du don yod grub pa: de rnams kyis gtso byas zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis: kun tu bzang po'i mdangs las 'bar ba lnga bcu rtsa brgyad: de'i spyi bor sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dang ldan pa: de'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi'i dbus su: gu ru thod phreng rtsal: shar du rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: lhor rat+na thod phreng rtsal: nub tu pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: byang du karma thod phreng rtsal:

de rnams thams cad kyang yab yum gyi rnam par bsam: mu khyud la rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam: pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la gu ru mtshan brgyad: g.yas ḍā ru g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa'o: de rnams la rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pas bskor ba: mu khyud la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba: gu ru thod phreng rtsal gyi spyi bor o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas: de'i spyi bor shrī sing ha: de'i spyi bor dga' rab rdo rje: de'i spyi bor rdo rje 'chang chen po: de'i spyi bor kun tu bzang po yab yum: gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sprin 'thib pa bzhin bzhugs par bsam: rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad til gyi sgong bu kha bye ba lta bur dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis them 'gag nem 'gag bzhugs par bsgom: de rnams thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra di ri ri: phyi'i 'byung ba yang de dang 'dra bar bsgom: thun 'jog pa'i dus su dbyer med pa'i ngang la bzhag go ༈ gsang ba ltar du bzlas pa ni: rang lus gong ltar rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum: spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang dbyer med par bsgom: gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams sprin 'thib pa lta bur bsam: kun tu bzang po'i thugs ka nas hūṃ mthing ga 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa de las hūṃ yar 'phros spyi gtsug tu rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka na zla ba nya gang ba gcig bsam: de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ dkar po gcig bsam: rgyud ltar g.yon slar dpyad mar skor du brgyud par bsam: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad hūṃ gis khengs par bsam mo: de ltar 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du rgyun ma chad par bsgom mo: bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gsang gsum rdzogs so: ༄༅/ /de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dngos med mtha' bral ka dag chos kyi sku/ /rang rig gsal dngas lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs/

/kun khyab shar grol sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /dus gsum rang rig bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /dmigs med chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang du/ /kun bzang yab yum nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngo bo ka dag rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun grub rang gsal 'od kyi gzhal yas su/ /longs sku zhi khro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig pa sku ru smin par byin gyis rlobs/ / thugs rje phyogs ris med pa'i pho brang du/ /sprul sku rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang sems 'dzin pa stongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i pho brang du/ /dga' rab rdo rje'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos nyid don dang mjal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dur khrod so sa gling gi pho brang du/ /shrī sing ha nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde chen 'du 'bral med par byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du/ /o rgyan pad+ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / gzho stod te sgro brag gi pho brang du/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' spyod rig 'dzin dag pa'i pho brang du/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab don dgongs pa rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /byar yul gro sa lung gi dgon pa ru/ /rgyal sras legs ldan pa la gsol ba 'debs/ / bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /la rgyab lhun grub steng gi gdan sa ru/ /rang byung rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro don lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam dag lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas su/ /dar ma rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khrul pa rang sar dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /gar bzhugs dag pa chos kyi pho brang na/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos nyid bden pa mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/

/bskyed rdzogs brtan pa thob pa'i pho brang na/ /tshul khrims 'bum pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku lnga lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid sgyu mar rtogs pa'i pho brang na/ /dharma lak+ṣa'i zhabs la gsob 'debs/ /a 'thas 'khrul pa zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' dang dam tshig dag pa'i pho brang na/ /bud+dha shrī'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / log rtog dri ma dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /spyi gtsug bde ba chen po'i gzhal yas su/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab don snying po lon par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang lus rnam par dag pa'i pho brang du/ / zhi khro ḍāk+ki'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang snang rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /ldang lha khra mo brag gi dben gnas su/ /mkha' 'gro snying thig nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdos bcas 'od lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba'i pho brang na/ /bka' bdag gter srung rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rkyen snang bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rig pa tshad la phebs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyams snang gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bden pa mngon du mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ghar dam pa'i sgrub gnas shug tshar dpal gyi dgon par bdag 'phags pa dpon po dar ma bzang pos/ 'gro ba rnams bde chen rtogs pa'i sems bskyed dang ldan pas snying tig gi yig cha cha tshang bar bzhengs pa 'di'i dge bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas te 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po myur du skems par shog cig /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gsang gsum/ - PAGE 38 -- PAGE 39 - - PAGE 32 -
